notes.title: 『Dr. Mememe Wants to Sleep』 will be exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2025!!
notes.content: [p]Hello, this is namase, the developer.[/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to announce that "Dr. Mememe Wants to Sleep" will be exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2025, held in Tokyo for 4 days starting September 25th (Thu)![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536415/50d756422bd6788490738609b67160a5600cdb5b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Event Details:[/p][p][/p][p]Date: [/p][p]September 25 (Thu) - September 28 (Sun), 2025[/p][p]Note:[/p][p]September 25-26 are Business Days, September 27-28 are open to the public.[/p][p][/p][p]For more details, please visit the official[/p][p][/p][p]website:[/p][p] [url="https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/"]https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Venue:[/p][p]Makuhari Messe[/p][p][/p][p]Our Booth:[/p][p]Hall 10, Booth Number: 10-C09 (iGi indie Game incubator / Sofu Booth)[/p]

notes.title: 『Dr.Mememe Wants to Sleep』 will be exhibited at BitSummit the 13th !!
notes.content: [p][b]Hello, this is namase, the developer.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to announce that "Dr. Mememe Wants to Sleep" will be exhibited at BitSummit the 13th Summer of Yokai, held in Kyoto for 3 days starting July 18th (Fri)![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536415/50d756422bd6788490738609b67160a5600cdb5b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Event Details:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Date:[/b] July 18 (Fri) - July 20 (Sun), 2025, 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: July 19 is Business Day, July 20-21 are open to the public.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]For more details, please visit the official website: [/p][list][*][p][url="https://bitsummit.org/"]https://bitsummit.org/[/url][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Our Booth[/b][/p][list][*][p]Kyoto Miyakomesse SV-05 (iGi indie Game incubator)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We're currently developing a demo build with new features for the event![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536415/e173f81061a5330f4be9ba28014ed3462c45b814.gif"][/img][/p][p]We're planning to participate in many more indie game events this year. Please come by and play our game![/p][p][/p]
